about: Images of four posts from Tokscale's own Instagram account (@tokscaleai), resized to 540x720 WebP for the home page. Each links to its post.

posts.firstLine: In September 2026, just 63 accounts on Tokscale used as many AI tokens as the other 926 combined.
Codex showed up in more accounts. Claude Code moved more tokens.
You opened your laptop for one small fix. Now the sky outside is turning blue.
SoftBank has delivered on its $30 billion commitment to OpenAI.
